research_question: How does processed-power fraction affect measured total conversion efficiency in partial-power DC-DC systems?
metric_definition: Measured total/system conversion efficiency paired with fraction of total transferred power processed by active converter stages
boundary_scope: Partial-power system including direct/bypass path and active converter stages
power_flow_direction: direction-specific; charging/source-to-load values must not be collapsed with reverse direction
isolation_scope: isolation may vary only if not used for scalar efficiency ranking
input_voltage_scope: must be explicitly reported for each point
output_voltage_scope: must be explicitly reported for each point
load_point_basis: same or explicitly mapped load/voltage operating point for efficiency and processed-power ratio
semiconductor_scope: explicit device technology retained as covariate
auxiliary_loss_policy: included/excluded auxiliary losses must be known before direct efficiency ranking
measurement_basis: full-text experimental measurement with figure/table/section locator
normalization_rule: units normalized; processed-power ratio expressed as percent of total transferred power; directions kept separate
admissible_mismatch: architecture may differ for bounded trade-off, but boundary and operating point may not be unknown
prohibited_inference: Do not rank partial-power system efficiency against full-power converter efficiency; do not infer gap from missing ratio
blocking_reasons: 0002 lacks a verified processed-power fraction at the efficiency claim point; 0004 has processed-power evidence but no normalized ratio claim extracted; voltage/power operating points are not yet normalized
next_acquisition_target: Acquire/extract 5-25 kW series/IPOS partial-power papers with explicit processed-power ratio, direction, voltage condition, and total-system efficiency curves

research_question: Under matched DAB operating conditions, how do modulation strategies trade RMS current, ZVS range, and measured efficiency?
metric_definition: Converter efficiency, RMS inductor/transformer current, and switch-level ZVS coverage under an identified modulation strategy
boundary_scope: DAB DC-DC converter power stage; NPC variants must be separated from conventional two-level DAB for direct ranking
power_flow_direction: same transfer direction per compared point
topology_scope: conventional two-level DAB preferred for direct set; NPC-DAB may be context covariate
input_voltage_scope: must be reported and matched by voltage-ratio regime
output_voltage_scope: must be reported and matched by voltage-ratio regime
switching_frequency_scope: reported and retained; no cross-frequency ranking without matched design intent
load_point_basis: matched voltage ratio and load fraction; peak efficiency alone is insufficient
semiconductor_scope: device technology retained; WBG/Si differences explicit
auxiliary_loss_policy: auxiliary-loss inclusion required for direct efficiency ranking
measurement_basis: full-text hardware measurements with efficiency curve and ZVS/RMS locators
normalization_rule: RMS current normalized only with same current base; voltage ratio and load fraction retained
admissible_mismatch: different modulation families allowed; topology level and operating-point regime may not be silently changed
prohibited_inference: Do not treat qualitative ZVS waveforms as full-range numerical ZVS; do not compare model accuracy to efficiency
blocking_reasons: 0005/0006/0008 remain L3; exact numerical RMS/backflow/efficiency claims are incomplete; 0011 is NPC-DAB rather than the same bridge topology; operating voltage/load points are unmatched
next_acquisition_target: Acquire/extract 1-5 kW conventional DAB papers with full-switch ZVS, RMS-current metric, efficiency curve, and explicit Vin/Vout/load points under comparable phase-shift families

research_question: What is the efficiency/power-density trade-off of high-power isolated soft-switched DC transformers?
metric_definition: Measured DCX conversion efficiency paired with declared converter power density and switching frequency
boundary_scope: isolated fixed/near-fixed-ratio DC transformer power stage
power_flow_direction: single forward direction per compared operating point; bidirectional capability retained as attribute
topology_scope: resonant DCX families may differ only for bounded trade-off, not flat ranking
input_voltage_scope: 400-800 V class target for direct acquisition
output_voltage_scope: matched ratio/output class required for direct ranking
load_point_basis: full-load or matched load-fraction curve points
auxiliary_loss_policy: auxiliary gate-drive/controller/cooling inclusion must be matched or direct efficiency ranking disabled
measurement_basis: instrumented or calorimetric measurement method explicitly recorded
normalization_rule: power-density units may be converted only after included-volume boundary matches
admissible_mismatch: topology may differ for bounded trade-off; voltage class, frequency decade, and volume boundary may not be unknown
prohibited_inference: Do not rank power density from unit conversion alone; do not rank calorimetric and differently bounded efficiencies without boundary reconciliation
blocking_reasons: CLLC-DCX at ~500 kHz and 750 V class is not directly comparable with 7 kV/400 V SRC at 48 kHz; efficiency measurement boundaries also differ
next_acquisition_target: Acquire 10-30 kW isolated DCX papers in the 400-800 V class with 300-600 kHz switching, auxiliary-inclusive efficiency, and compatible volume definitions

research_question: For non-isolated high-gain DC-DC converters, what trade-off exists among gain, semiconductor stress, soft switching, and efficiency?
metric_definition: Measured voltage gain/output, semiconductor stress normalized to the same electrical boundary, verified soft-switching condition, and converter efficiency
boundary_scope: non-isolated high-gain DC-DC converter power stage
load_point_basis: same load fraction or matched output-power region
auxiliary_loss_policy: auxiliary-loss policy must be stated for direct efficiency ranking
measurement_basis: full-text hardware waveforms and measured efficiency/stress locators
normalization_rule: voltage gain and normalized stress use measured electrical boundaries; design targets remain separate
admissible_mismatch: topology may differ for bounded trade-off if gain and stress denominators match
prohibited_inference: Do not substitute design-target output for measured output; do not compare raw switch voltage without common normalization denominator
blocking_reasons: Only one numerically verified independent paper is present; no cross-paper set can be formed
next_acquisition_target: Acquire 100-500 W non-isolated high-gain prototypes near 20-40 V input, 300-400 V output, and 50-100 kHz with measured stress, efficiency, and soft-switching locators

research_question: Can variable-turns-ratio partial-power OBCs maintain soft switching and high system efficiency across battery voltage range?
metric_definition: Direction-specific OBC DC-DC system efficiency paired with processed-power fraction and verified switch-level soft-switching range across battery voltage
boundary_scope: partial-power OBC DC-DC stage including direct path and active conversion path
power_flow_direction: charging direction primary; discharging evaluated separately
isolation_scope: isolation role must be explicitly located in system architecture
topology_scope: series-connected partial-power OBC with variable turns ratio/reconfigurable bridge
load_point_basis: battery-voltage sweep with matched charge-current/load condition
auxiliary_loss_policy: system efficiency boundary and auxiliary supply inclusion must be stated
measurement_basis: full-text hardware efficiency curve plus ZCS/ZVS waveform/region locators
normalization_rule: processed-power ratio normalized to total battery power at each battery-voltage point
admissible_mismatch: turns-ratio regions may differ if mapped; abstract-only values are inadmissible
prohibited_inference: Do not promote abstract efficiency or assume full-range ZCS/ZVS from summary wording
blocking_reasons: 0013 is only L1 because legal/readable full text is unresolved; abstract-level 98.7% cannot enter verified comparison
next_acquisition_target: Resolve a legal/readable full text for 0013 and extract efficiency versus battery voltage, processed-power ratio, ZCS/ZVS range, and exact measurement boundary
